scope: Open/enclosed occupant presence, power, battle-destiny ability and character weapon firing/targeting; vehicle defense and equal-defense miss; separate passenger/carrier forfeiture; printed free movement and mixed-party docking transit.
method: Vehicles and crew deploy through actual GEMP actions. Locations, Force, opposing combatants, attached weapons and top destiny cards are controlled fixtures. Movement, battle, firing and forfeiting use production actions.

Thirteen native action replays compare complete recorded results, restoring JSON at every command. Two canceled-text reference movements compare the native projected cost from equivalent trusted canceled-text state only; they do not claim a native cancellation provider or persisted cancellation action.

Native uses the same printed starting site and characters. Lost-card ordering is chosen explicitly when the reference requests it. Printed open/enclosed characteristics come from the pinned source, including enclosed V-35 and Ubrikkian.
limitations: This is component coverage, not full card or deck admission. Native supports() remains false.
Vehicle reactions, optional embarking/disembarking around a react, cancellation and react history remain required next work. No new standalone Rules Lab study.

Ubrikkian deployment/capacity, cargo-contained open crew, driver departure, and responsive recovery have native checks beyond these reference observations. General vessel stat modifiers, broader aboard movement-card interactions, capture/sectors and the full catalog/product scope remain unfinished.
